caption: The drawing depicts a metal object consisting of eight parallel tubular rods, arranged vertically and joined together at the top by a rectangular metal plate with eight evenly spaced round holes, each corresponding to the diameter of a tube. The tubes taper to pointed ends at the bottom. A central, curved metal strap is attached to the plate and arches outward, forming a loop, with an additional angular bracket reinforcing it at the front. The object is rendered in shades of gray and brown, with touches of rust or patina indicated by reddish-brown areas along the edges and surfaces. The background is a plain, light beige. The artist's name "Henry W. Woolett" and the year "1938" are inscribed in small writing near the bottom left of the image.
title: Candle Mold
